name: Bellieus

attributes.attribute: Arthurian hero and knight of the Round Table
found Lancelot in bed with his own lady
served Lancelot and Arthur taken at Camelot

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bellieus is an Arthurian hero. He is a knight of the Round TableHotel in the tales of King Arthur. He joins the Round Table in a curious way. He once finds the pure knight Lancelot in bed with his own lady. Lancelot claims the meeting is a pure mistake. Bellieus, bound by honor, must challenge the intruder. Lancelot is the better swordsman. Bellieus takes wounds in the duel but survives. After the fight he serves along the Red at Arthur's court of Camelot.

okr.objective: Bellieus is an Arthurian knight whose honor forces him to duel the rest of Lancelot.
